objective: Verify the custom Peanuts Skill is discoverable and applied in ordinary Claude chat without a Claude Code slash command.
scenario: The owner installs and enables Peanuts in claude.ai, then starts a regular chat in the Friday Project and asks for ideation support.

input.prompt: Use the Peanuts Skill to help me assess this idea
input.expected_surface_behavior: Claude selects the enabled custom Skill when relevant; user may explicitly mention the Skill

expected_behaviors: Use the enabled Peanuts Skill when the task is relevant, or report clearly if it is not available.
Apply the shared canonical Peanuts methods rather than a Claude-specific alternate workflow.
Do not require the Claude Code slash command in ordinary chat.
prohibited_behaviors: Claim the skill is activated when it is not visible/enabled.
Tell the user to invoke /peanuts in ordinary Claude chat.
